description: Bilingual AI work-method coach that turns workplace problems into structured actions using practical management methods.

defaultPrompt: Help me handle a workplace problem. / 幫我處理一個工作問題。
Help me choose the right work method. / 幫我選擇適合的工作方法。
Apply a method I specify. / 使用我指定的工作方法。
interface.longDescription: EW AI Work Coach helps users apply practical workplace methods without needing to master management theory first. Describe the real problem, and the coach selects or confirms a suitable method, asks only for missing critical information, distinguishes facts from assumptions, and produces an actionable work card. EW AI Work Coach 協助使用者把真實工作問題轉成可執行成果：選擇或確認適合的方法、補足必要資訊、區分事實與假設，並形成可追蹤、可檢查的工作卡。
interface.shortDescription: Work problem to action｜工作問題到行動

name: ew-ai-work-coach
